rules.reference: existing frozen success bank; not reference-free
rules.candidate_pool: default candidate 0 and three iid-noise candidates at identical observation; batch=1
rules.trigger: external frozen alarm; no candidate may redefine the trigger
rules.expansion: only if default has an available above-threshold continuous signal
rules.dominance: no increase in any positive threshold excess, decrease in at least one active excess
rules.action_guard: same gripper signs on the executed prefix; continuous-command RMS change <= finite pool median
rules.action_resolution: RMS change must exceed numerical float32 tolerance
rules.ranking: fewest remaining above-threshold signals, then smallest action RMS change, then candidate ID
rules.abstention: candidate 0 when untriggered, no active signal, missing baseline evidence or no admissible alternative
rules.commit: score on private copies of executed history; commit only the dispatched candidate
rules.rollout: one selected native-length chunk at q+1, then ordinary policy; original horizon
rules.cost: 1 forward normally, 4 when expanded; no hidden/probe/critic or additional training
rules.interpretation: heuristic signal dominance, not a success-probability or safety certificate

cohort: all parents from the existing validation audit; primary role=perturbation
timing: first frozen Euclidean kNN alarm q+1 only; one whole native chunk
outcome_use: decisions saved before joining suffix labels; labels historically known, not blinded validation
hypotheses: descriptive test of frozen signal dominance; no tuning after this replay
cost: counterfactual deployment: one forward by default, four if expanded; original horizon
